title: max_diff_pct retired from the UI, not enforced in the engine
mode: offline; no orders, no engine start, no append_only writes, no matrix edits

decision_reading.question_1: The bound is not supposed to exist per wallet. OD-10 records the entry price bound as ONE bound per order, enforced from Global Controls marketable_bps at the send decision; the per-wallet variant still awaits an Architect ruling against Build 4 I20 0%.
evidence: OD-10 open_decisions.json: the entry price bound (Build 4 I20 0% vs Build 3 max_diff_pct) is still open; Build 3 has per-wallet max_diff_pct default 0.1 and marketable offset 5.
OD-06: boss ruled global controls must all function; OD-10 defers the entry price bound to that same surface.

HL_Live_Copy_Service_Core.py: ZERO code occurrences of max_diff_pct. The enforced bound is marketable_bps (Core:6045 mult, Core:6076 missed_entry_decision cap_px, Core:6106 close adverse gate), proven by test_core_missed_entry_rule M1/M2.
Matrix applicability RISK-010 = OPEN_DECISION on OD-10, owner Architect; per-wallet engine code would pre-empt an open architectural decision.
decision_reading.why_retire: Enforcing would invent an unauthorised per-wallet bound in a second place competing with the global marketable_bps bound OD-10 already places at the send decision. Retiring removes the false assurance without changing enforced risk behaviour.

question_2.claim: the UI drops max_diff_pct on save
question_2.evidence: HL_Copy_App_SSOT.py:987 ENGINE_IGNORED_WALLET_KEYS includes max_diff_pct; :1008 the normaliser drops it. Introduced by 741aa2d (2026-10-09) a day after the 13 May screen was restored verbatim at 91e9980; test_core_dex_scope_and_ui_truth U5 pins it.
question_2.consequence: The save path was already correct, so no save fix was needed. The missing last mile was disk state: a hand-written value stayed on disk and read as a live bound. This card closes that.

hunks: comment above ENGINE_IGNORED_WALLET_KEYS recording the OD-10 retirement, which bound is actually enforced, and that the key returns only together with the Core reader AND the panel input in one change

repair_live_config_consistency(): pop every ENGINE_IGNORED_WALLET_KEYS member from a wallet config and report changed=True, so a retired key already on disk is removed instead of lingering as a live-looking bound
diff.line_endings: File is CRLF; the edit was applied at BYTE level with a roundtrip assertion nl.join(split)==original, because a text-mode rewrite produced 420/405 of pure line-ending churn. Final diff is 15 insertions, 0 deletions.

census.detail: ENGINE_IGNORED_WALLET_KEYS contains max_diff_pct; render_live_copy_control_panel() has no name=max_diff_pct; a line census of the Core finds zero non-comment code lines matching max_diff_pct

regression_sweep.pre_existing_detail: W2_ELEVEN_ACTIVE_WALLETS_REFUSED_AT_START fails because a live engine holds the single-writer lock (hl_live_copy_audit_testnet). Proven not mine by re-running with this diff stashed: identical FAIL.

claim_boundary.does_prove: The per-wallet max_diff_pct key is not read by the Core, not offered by the panel, not persisted by the real save route, and is actively removed from a config that still carries it. The bound that IS enforced (Global Controls marketable_bps) refuses an entry priced beyond it before the exchange, on the engine real send path.
does_not_prove: that a per-wallet bound is the wrong product decision -- OD-10 is open and owned by the Architect; this card takes the only reading the decisions currently support and records the return path
any behaviour against a real exchange: the send path ran with a fake exchange client and no network
that no other UI field shares this failure shape -- only max_diff_pct was examined
that the live production live_config.json has been repaired -- the repair runs on the next load in the real app, which was not started
not_changed: no change to Global Controls or any enforced risk gate
